title.narrative: Preserving Ukraine¿s Jewish documentary heritage, honouring collective memory, enhancing knowledge and access to archives while promoting intercultural dialogue

description.narrative: project devoted to preserving cultural and documentary heritage, and particularly the Jewish community in Ukraine, as a key source for preventing antisemitism, educating about the Holocaust and genocides and enhance respect for human rights. The project also aims to facilitate access to this heritage and aims to raise awareness of Jewish cultural heritage in Ukraine. As such, the principal objective of the activities conducted as part of this project is to preserve and enable access to cultural and documentary heritage of the Jewish community in Ukraine, while fostering the recognition of such cultural heritage and its valuable contribution to the diversity of expressions and history of Ukraine.
